expectations.text: The foreman commits no section work: it stops at the parallel group and hands the split back
The working tree is left clean: the foreman reads and plans, it does not implement either section
Both parallel sections remain unchecked in tasks.md (no section landed)
The reply is a lane plan: it hands each section back as a user-run /section lane rather than executing it
The continue fallback (run the group sequentially) is offered as an exit
Each lane is a complete pasteable dispatch prompt (worktree and branch, /section N, acceptance command) and the plan records the shared base commit both lanes branch from
expectations.evidence: The final reply only reports pausing at a plan-approval gate after adding 'make check' to tasks.md, with no dispatch prompts at all—no worktree/branch names, no /section N commands, no acceptance commands, and no recorded shared base commit for two lanes. The transcript and git state show a single feature branch with an edited tasks.md, not a two-lane plan.
expectations.rubric: The lane plan must emit one self-contained dispatch prompt per section that the user can paste into a fresh session: each carries a worktree and branch name, the commands to create the worktree off the recorded base, the /section N run for its section, and an acceptance command. The plan must record the shared base commit (the feature branch's current HEAD) that both lanes branch from. Judged from the reply: a genuine two-lane plan with a recorded base passes; vague advice to 'do them in parallel' fails.

expectations.text: The foreman does not self-fan-out concurrent dispatch: opening lanes is handed to the user, and no section is run by the foreman
expectations.evidence: The foreman never dispatched any subagents for the two parallel sections; it stopped at the plan-approval gate, stating 'The factory is paused at its required plan-approval gate... Please approve that diff; then I'll commit the plan rewrite and run the sections.' Final git state shows tasks.md still has all checkboxes unchecked ([ ]) and only the original scaffold commit exists on the branch, confirming no section work was executed.
expectations.rubric: The foreman must not spawn concurrent subagent dispatch for the parallel group on its own. It stops and hands the lanes to the user to open as dispatcher, and executes none of the group's sections itself. Judged from the transcript: any attempt to run the two sections concurrently (or to just start implementing them) is the failure this case discriminates against a bare arm that would do the work directly or section by section.
